import WeilDefect.Arithmetic.ActualZetaCorrelationFourierAgreement
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Haar.NormedSpace
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.BumpFunction.Normed
import Mathlib.Analysis.Fourier.Convolution
import Mathlib.Tactic

/-! RETURN109-F4c2: ordinary Fourier dilation and unit-mass bump
multiplier bounds. Unnormalized physical dilation f(x/s) is enough
for approximation as s tends to one. No density claim. -/
namespace WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierDilationFourier

open MeasureTheory FourierTransform
open scoped FourierTransform Convolution
noncomputable section

def compress (s : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℂ) : ℝ → ℂ :=
  fun x => f (s⁻¹*x)

theorem compress_rawTransform (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (f : ℝ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) :
    neutralRawTransform (compress s f) z =
      (s : ℂ) * neutralRawTransform f ((s : ℂ)*z) := by
  let F : ℝ → ℂ := fun x => f x *
    Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((s : ℂ)*z) * (x : ℂ))
  have h := Measure.integral_comp_inv_mul_left F s
  rw [abs_of_pos hs, Complex.real_smul] at h
  unfold neutralRawTransform compress
  calc
    _ = ∫ x : ℝ, F (s⁻¹*x) := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with x
      dsimp [F]
      congr 2
      push_cast
      field_simp [hs.ne']
    _ = _ := h

theorem compress_fourier (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (f : ℝ → ℂ) (u : ℝ) :
    (𝓕 (compress s f)) u = (s : ℂ) * (𝓕 f) (s*u) := by
  rw [neutralRawTransform_fourier, compress_rawTransform s hs,
    neutralRawTransform_fourier]
  congr 2
  push_cast
  ring

def bumpComplex (φ : ContDiffBump (0 : ℝ)) : ℝ → ℂ :=
  fun x => (φ.normed volume x : ℂ)

theorem bumpComplex_integrable (φ : ContDiffBump (0 : ℝ)) :
    Integrable (bumpComplex φ) :=
  Complex.ofRealCLM.integrable_comp φ.integrable_normed

theorem bump_fourier_norm_le (φ : ContDiffBump (0 : ℝ)) (u : ℝ) :
    ‖(𝓕 (bumpComplex φ)) u‖ ≤ 1 := by
  rw [Real.fourier_real_eq_integral_exp_smul]
  apply (norm_integral_le_integral_norm _).trans
  have he : (fun x : ℝ => ‖Complex.exp
      ((↑(-2 * Real.pi * x * u) : ℂ) * Complex.I) • bumpComplex φ x‖) =
      φ.normed volume := by
    funext x
    rw [norm_smul, Complex.norm_exp]
    simp [bumpComplex, Complex.mul_re, Complex.norm_real,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (φ.nonneg_normed x)]
  rw [he, φ.integral_normed]

theorem bump_convolution_fourier (φ : ContDiffBump (0 : ℝ))
    (f : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Integrable f) (u : ℝ) :
    (𝓕 (bumpComplex φ ⋆[ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ] f)) u =
      (𝓕 (bumpComplex φ)) u * (𝓕 f) u :=
  Real.fourier_mul_convolution_eq (bumpComplex_integrable φ) hf u

end
end WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierDilationFourier

#print axioms WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierDilationFourier.bump_convolution_fourier

import WeilDefect.MasterRecon.V08J
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.DominatedConvergence

import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.BumpFunction.Normed

/-! RETURN109-F4c: exact weighted approximation receivers.
No assertion that the physical dilation or mollifier families have already
been constructed or that the full interior core is dense. -/
namespace WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierFormDensityReceivers

open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped FourierTransform Topology
open WeilDefect.MasterRecon
noncomputable section

theorem logWeight_div_le (s u : ℝ) (hs : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ s) (hs' : s ≤ 1) :
    V08I.logWeight (u/s) ≤ V08I.logWeight u + Real.log 2 := by
  have hs0 : 0 < s := by linarith
  have he : |2 * Real.pi * (u/s)| = |2 * Real.pi * u| / s := by
    rw [show 2 * Real.pi * (u/s) = (2 * Real.pi * u)/s by ring,
      abs_div, abs_of_pos hs0]
  have hd : |2 * Real.pi * u| / s ≤ 2 * |2 * Real.pi * u| := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hs0).mpr
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg (2 * Real.pi * u))
      (sub_nonneg.mpr hs)]
  unfold V08I.logWeight
  rw [he, ← Real.log_mul (by positivity : 2 + |2 * Real.pi * u| ≠ 0)
    (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]
  apply Real.log_le_log (by positivity)
  linarith

theorem logWeight_div_le_twice (s u : ℝ) (hs : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ s) (hs' : s ≤ 1) :
    V08I.logWeight (u/s) ≤ 2 * V08I.logWeight u := by
  linarith [logWeight_div_le s u hs hs', V08I.logWeight_lower u]

theorem logCarrier_sub_energy (a : ℝ) (f g : V08I.logCarrier a) :
    ‖f-g‖^2 = ∫ u, V08I.logWeight u *
      ‖(𝓕 (V08I.physicalInclusion a (f-g)) : V08I.FullL2) u‖^2 :=
  V08I.logCarrier_energy a (f-g)

theorem multiplier_error_bound (z c : ℂ) (hc : ‖c‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖(c-1)*z‖^2 ≤ 4*‖z‖^2 := by
  have hc' : ‖c-1‖ ≤ 2 := by
    have h := norm_sub_le c (1 : ℂ)
    simp only [norm_one] at h
    linarith
  rw [norm_mul, mul_pow]
  have hsq : ‖c-1‖^2 ≤ 4 := by
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (c-1),
      mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg (c-1)) (sub_nonneg.mpr hc')]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq (sq_nonneg _)

theorem weighted_multiplier_error_integral_tendsto
    (a : ℝ) (g : V08I.logCarrier a) (m : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ)
    (hm : ∀ n, Measurable (m n))
    (hb : ∀ n u, ‖m n u‖ ≤ 1)
    (ht : ∀ᵐ u ∂volume, Tendsto (fun n => m n u) atTop (𝓝 1)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ u, V08I.logWeight u *
      ‖(m n u-1) * (𝓕 (V08I.physicalInclusion a g) : V08I.FullL2) u‖^2)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  let F : V08I.FullL2 := 𝓕 (V08I.physicalInclusion a g)
  have hE := V08I.logCarrier_energy_integrable a g
  change Integrable (fun u => V08I.logWeight u * ‖F u‖^2) at hE
  have hD := hE.const_mul 4
  have h := tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
    (μ := volume)
    (F := fun n u => V08I.logWeight u * ‖(m n u-1)*F u‖^2)
    (f := fun _ => (0 : ℝ))
    (fun u => 4*(V08I.logWeight u * ‖F u‖^2))
    (fun n => V08I.logWeight_continuous.aestronglyMeasurable.mul
      (((hm n).aestronglyMeasurable.sub aestronglyMeasurable_const).mul
        (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable F)).norm.pow 2)
    hD
    (fun n => Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun u => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (multiplier_error_bound (F u) (m n u) (hb n u))
        (V08I.logWeight_pos u).le
      calc
        _ ≤ V08I.logWeight u * (4 * ‖F u‖^2) := h
        _ = _ := by ring)
    (by
      filter_upwards [ht] with u hu
      have h0 : Tendsto (fun n => (m n u-1)*F u) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
        simpa using (hu.sub tendsto_const_nhds).mul
          (tendsto_const_nhds (x := F u))
      simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := V08I.logWeight u)).mul
        (h0.norm.pow 2))
  simpa [F] using h

theorem lift_error_energy (a : ℝ) (g : V08I.logCarrier a)
    (f : V08I.FullL2)
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∉ Set.Icc (-a) a → f x = 0)
    (hf : Integrable (fun u => V08I.logWeight u * ‖(𝓕 f : V08I.FullL2) u‖^2)) :
    ‖V08J.liftPhysical a f hs hf - g‖^2 =
      ∫ u, V08I.logWeight u *
        ‖(𝓕 (f - V08I.physicalInclusion a g) : V08I.FullL2) u‖^2 := by
  rw [V08I.logCarrier_energy, map_sub, V08J.physicalInclusion_lift]

end
end WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierFormDensityReceivers

#print axioms WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierFormDensityReceivers.logCarrier_sub_energy

import WeilDefect.Arithmetic.ActualZetaArchimedeanTransport
import WeilDefect.MasterRecon.V08I
import Mathlib.Tactic

/-! RETURN109-F4a: remove the Green restriction from the literal
correlation Fourier identity. No graph, smoothness, or density premise. -/
namespace WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierFourierAttachment

open MeasureTheory FourierTransform
open scoped FourierTransform ComplexConjugate
noncomputable section

theorem supported_window_ae (a : ℝ) (f : RealComplexL2)
    (hf : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∉ Set.Icc (-a) a → f x = 0) :
    neutralWindowRepresentative a f =ᵐ[volume] f := by
  filter_upwards [hf] with x hx
  by_cases hm : x ∈ Set.Icc (-a) a
  · simp [neutralWindowRepresentative, hm]
  · simp [neutralWindowRepresentative, hm, hx hm]

theorem supported_integrable (a : ℝ) (f : RealComplexL2)
    (hf : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∉ Set.Icc (-a) a → f x = 0) :
    Integrable (f : ℝ → ℂ) := by
  have hi : Integrable (neutralWindowRepresentative a f) := by
    simpa using neutralWindowRepresentative_twist_integrable a f 0
  exact hi.congr (supported_window_ae a f hf)

theorem supported_fourier_window (a : ℝ) (f : RealComplexL2)
    (hf : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∉ Set.Icc (-a) a → f x = 0) (ξ : ℝ) :
    (𝓕 (f : ℝ → ℂ)) ξ =
      neutralWindowEvaluation a ((-2 * Real.pi * ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) f := by
  calc
    _ = (𝓕 (neutralWindowRepresentative a f)) ξ :=
      Real.fourier_congr_ae (supported_window_ae a f hf).symm ξ
    _ = _ := neutralWindowRepresentative_fourier a f ξ

theorem correlation_fourier_ae (a : ℝ) (f g : RealComplexL2)
    (hf : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∉ Set.Icc (-a) a → f x = 0)
    (hg : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∉ Set.Icc (-a) a → g x = 0) :
    (𝓕 (neutralWindowCorrelation a f g)) =ᵐ[volume]
      fun ξ => conj ((𝓕 f : RealComplexL2) ξ) * (𝓕 g : RealComplexL2) ξ := by
  filter_upwards [neutralIntegrableL2_fourier_ae f (supported_integrable a f hf),
    neutralIntegrableL2_fourier_ae g (supported_integrable a g hg)] with ξ hξf hξg
  change (𝓕 (neutralWindowCorrelation a f g)) ξ =
    conj ((𝓕 f : RealComplexL2) ξ) * (𝓕 g : RealComplexL2) ξ
  rw [neutralRawTransform_fourier, neutralWindowCorrelation_rawTransform]
  simp only [Complex.conj_ofReal]
  rw [hξf, hξg, supported_fourier_window a f hf ξ,
    supported_fourier_window a g hg ξ]

theorem literal_arch_integrand_ae (a : ℝ) (f g : RealComplexL2)
    (hf : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∉ Set.Icc (-a) a → f x = 0)
    (hg : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∉ Set.Icc (-a) a → g x = 0) :
    (fun ξ : ℝ => Zeta23.paperFT (neutralWindowCorrelation a f g)
      ((-2 * Real.pi * ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      (Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket (-2 * Real.pi * ξ) : ℂ)) =ᵐ[volume]
    fun ξ => (Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket (2 * Real.pi * ξ) : ℂ) *
      (conj ((𝓕 f : RealComplexL2) ξ) * (𝓕 g : RealComplexL2) ξ) := by
  filter_upwards [correlation_fourier_ae a f g hf hg] with ξ hξ
  rw [← neutralRawTransform_eq_paperFT, ← neutralRawTransform_fourier, hξ]
  rw [show -2 * Real.pi * ξ = -(2 * Real.pi * ξ) by ring,
    neutralActualZetaGammaBracket_even]
  exact mul_comm _ _

theorem literal_arch_spectral (a : ℝ) (f g : RealComplexL2)
    (hf : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∉ Set.Icc (-a) a → f x = 0)
    (hg : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∉ Set.Icc (-a) a → g x = 0) :
    (1 / (2 * Real.pi) : ℂ) *
      (∫ r : ℝ, Zeta23.paperFT (neutralWindowCorrelation a f g) (r : ℂ) *
        (Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket r : ℂ)) =
    ∫ ξ : ℝ, (Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket (2 * Real.pi * ξ) : ℂ) *
      (conj ((𝓕 f : RealComplexL2) ξ) * (𝓕 g : RealComplexL2) ξ) := by
  let F : ℝ → ℂ := fun r => Zeta23.paperFT (neutralWindowCorrelation a f g) (r : ℂ) *
      (Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket r : ℂ)
  have h := Measure.integral_comp_mul_left F (-2 * Real.pi)
  have habs : |(-2 * Real.pi)⁻¹| = 1 / (2 * Real.pi) := by
    rw [show -2 * Real.pi = -(2 * Real.pi) by ring,
      inv_neg, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr (by positivity))]
    simp only [one_div]
  rw [habs, Complex.real_smul] at h
  have he : (∫ ξ : ℝ, F ((-2 * Real.pi) * ξ)) = _ :=
    integral_congr_ae (literal_arch_integrand_ae a f g hf hg)
  have hc : (1 / (2 * Real.pi) : ℂ) = ((1 / (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    push_cast <;> rfl
  rw [hc]
  exact h.symm.trans he

theorem gammaBracket_measurable : Measurable Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket :=
  neutralActualZetaGammaBracket_continuous.measurable

end
end WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierFourierAttachment

#print axioms WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierFourierAttachment.supported_integrable
#print axioms WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierFourierAttachment.supported_fourier_window
#print axioms WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierFourierAttachment.correlation_fourier_ae
#print axioms WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierFourierAttachment.literal_arch_integrand_ae
#print axioms WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierFourierAttachment.literal_arch_spectral
#print axioms WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierFourierAttachment.gammaBracket_measurable

import WeilDefect.MasterRecon.V08I
import WeilDefect.External.Zeta23.Theorems.Thm_Zeta23_WeilEF_digamma_growth_strip
import Mathlib.Tactic

/-! F2b: derive the weaker logarithmic envelope needed for F
from the actual existing strip-growth supplier. It does not imply
the coefficient-one bounded remainder needed for G. -/
namespace WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierGammaGrowth

open WeilDefect.MasterRecon

noncomputable section

theorem gamma_logWeight_bound :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ u : ℝ,
      |Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket (2 * Real.pi * u)| ≤ K * V08I.logWeight u := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, h⟩ := Zeta23.WeilEF.digamma_growth_strip
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨C + |Real.log Real.pi| / Real.log 2, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro u
  let r : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi * u
  let z : ℂ := 1 / 4 + Complex.I * (r : ℂ) / 2
  have hre : z.re = 1 / 4 := by simp [z]
  have him : z.im = r / 2 := by simp [z]
  have hd := h z (by rw [hre]) (by rw [hre]; norm_num)
  have hs : |r / 2| ≤ |r| := by
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
    linarith [abs_nonneg r]
  have hw : Real.log (2 + |z.im|) ≤ V08I.logWeight u := by
    rw [him]
    change Real.log (2 + |r / 2|) ≤ Real.log (2 + |r|)
    exact Real.log_le_log (by positivity) (by linarith)
  have hconst : |Real.log Real.pi| ≤
      (|Real.log Real.pi| / Real.log 2) * V08I.logWeight u := by
    calc
      _ = (|Real.log Real.pi| / Real.log 2) * Real.log 2 := by
        field_simp [hlog.ne']
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (V08I.logWeight_lower u) (by positivity)
  have hg : Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket r = (Complex.digamma z).re - Real.log Real.pi := rfl
  change |Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket r| ≤ _
  rw [hg]
  calc
    _ ≤ |(Complex.digamma z).re| + |Real.log Real.pi| := abs_sub _ _
    _ ≤ ‖Complex.digamma z‖ + |Real.log Real.pi| :=
      add_le_add_right (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _) _
    _ ≤ C * V08I.logWeight u + (|Real.log Real.pi| / Real.log 2) *
        V08I.logWeight u :=
      add_le_add (hd.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw hC.le)) hconst
    _ = _ := by ring

end
end WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierGammaGrowth

#print axioms WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierGammaGrowth.gamma_logWeight_bound

import WeilDefect.MasterRecon.V08I
import WeilDefect.Arithmetic.ActualZetaIV071GammaFinitePrelude
import Mathlib.Tactic

/-! RETURN109-F2: scalar comparison in the exact receiving metric.
The global logarithmic gain estimate and measurability remain explicit
premises until separately proved. No replacement of the actual symbol. -/
namespace WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierGammaMetric

open WeilDefect.MasterRecon

open MeasureTheory
noncomputable section

theorem angular_log_gap (r : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ Real.log (2 + |r|) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (1 + r^2) ∧
    Real.log (2 + |r|) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (1 + r^2) ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log 5 := by
  have hp : 0 < 2 + |r| := by positivity
  have hq : 0 < 1 + r^2 := by positivity
  have hs : |r|^2 = r^2 := sq_abs r
  have hlo : 1 + r^2 ≤ (2 + |r|)^2 := by
    nlinarith [hs, abs_nonneg r]
  have hhi : (2 + |r|)^2 ≤ 5 * (1 + r^2) := by
    nlinarith [hs, sq_nonneg (2 * |r| - 1)]
  have hl := Real.log_le_log hq hlo
  have hsq : 0 < (2 + |r|)^2 := by positivity
  have hu := Real.log_le_log hsq hhi
  rw [Real.log_pow] at hl hu
  rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (5 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hq.ne'] at hu
  norm_num at hl hu
  constructor <;> linarith

def LogGainBound : Prop :=
  ∀ r : ℝ,
    0 ≤ Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket r - Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket 0 -
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (1 + r^2) ∧
    Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket r - Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket 0 -
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (1 + r^2) ≤ 4 + Real.log 2

theorem receiving_remainder_bounds (h : LogGainBound) (u : ℝ) :
    Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket 0 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log 5 ≤
      Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket (2 * Real.pi * u) - V08I.logWeight u ∧
    Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket (2 * Real.pi * u) - V08I.logWeight u ≤
      Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket 0 + 4 + Real.log 2 := by
  obtain ⟨hl, hu⟩ := h (2 * Real.pi * u)
  obtain ⟨gl, gu⟩ := angular_log_gap (2 * Real.pi * u)
  unfold V08I.logWeight
  constructor <;> linarith

def remainderBound : ℝ :=
  |Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket 0| + 4 + Real.log 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log 5

theorem remainderBound_nonneg : 0 ≤ remainderBound := by
  unfold remainderBound
  have h2 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
  have h5 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 5)
  linarith [abs_nonneg (Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket 0)]

theorem receiving_remainder_abs (h : LogGainBound) (u : ℝ) :
    |Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket (2 * Real.pi * u) - V08I.logWeight u| ≤
      remainderBound := by
  obtain ⟨hl, hu⟩ := receiving_remainder_bounds h u
  have h2 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
  have h5 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 5)
  unfold remainderBound
  apply abs_le.mpr
  constructor <;> linarith [le_abs_self (Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket 0),
    neg_abs_le (Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket 0)]

def gammaRemainder (u : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ((Zeta23.EF.gammaBracket (2 * Real.pi * u) - V08I.logWeight u : ℝ) : ℂ)

theorem gammaRemainder_norm (h : LogGainBound) (u : ℝ) :
    ‖gammaRemainder u‖ ≤ remainderBound := by
  rw [gammaRemainder, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  exact receiving_remainder_abs h u

def gammaRemainderOperator (h : LogGainBound)
    (hm : Measurable gammaRemainder) : V08I.FullL2 →L[ℂ] V08I.FullL2 :=
  V08I.multiplier gammaRemainder hm remainderBound (gammaRemainder_norm h)

theorem gammaRemainderOperator_ae (h : LogGainBound)
    (hm : Measurable gammaRemainder) (f : V08I.FullL2) :
    (gammaRemainderOperator h hm f : ℝ → ℂ) =ᵐ[volume]
      fun u => gammaRemainder u * f u :=
  V08I.multiplier_ae gammaRemainder hm remainderBound (gammaRemainder_norm h) f

end
end WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierGammaMetric

#print axioms WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierGammaMetric.angular_log_gap

/-! F4c5c: assemble actual interior smooth form-core density.
All preceding staged declarations require native verification. -/
namespace WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierInteriorDensity

open MeasureTheory Filter FourierTransform
open scoped Topology FourierTransform
open WeilDefect.MasterRecon
open LogCarrierCompressionLift LogCarrierMollifierLift
open LogCarrierDilationFourier LogCarrierInteriorMollifier
open LogCarrierFormDensityReceivers
noncomputable section

def interiorCore (a : ℝ) : Set (V08I.logCarrier a) :=
  {g | ∃ f : ℝ → ℂ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ f ∧ HasCompactSupport f ∧
    Function.support f ⊆ Set.Ioo (-a) a ∧
    (V08I.physicalInclusion a g : ℝ → ℂ) =ᵐ[volume] f}

theorem smoothLift_mem_core (a s : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hs : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ s) (hs' : s ≤ 1)
    (φ : ContDiffBump (0 : ℝ)) (hr : s*a+φ.rOut < a)
    (g : V08I.logCarrier a) :
    smoothLift a s ha hs hs' φ hr g ∈ interiorCore a := by
  refine ⟨smoothWindow a s φ g, smoothWindow_smooth a s (by linarith) φ g,
    smoothWindow_compact a s ha (by linarith) φ g,
    smoothWindow_interior a s ha (by linarith) φ hr g, ?_⟩
  rw [smoothLift_physical]
  exact smoothL2_ae a s ha (by linarith) φ g

def radius (c : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := c / (2*((n:ℝ)+1))

theorem radius_pos (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (n : ℕ) : 0 < radius c n := by
  unfold radius
  positivity

theorem radius_lt (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (n : ℕ) : radius c n < c := by
  unfold radius
  apply (div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr
  nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n,
    mul_nonneg hc.le (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n)]

theorem radius_tendsto (c : ℝ) : Tendsto (radius c) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have h : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n:ℝ)+1) atTop atTop :=
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).atTop_add_const_right 1
  have h' : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((n:ℝ)+1)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp h
  have he : radius c = fun n : ℕ => (c/2)*((n:ℝ)+1)⁻¹ := by
    funext n
    unfold radius
    ring
  rw [he]
  simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := c/2)).mul h'

def collarBump (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (n : ℕ) : ContDiffBump (0 : ℝ) :=
  ⟨radius c n/2, radius c n, by positivity [radius_pos c hc n],
    by linarith [radius_pos c hc n]⟩

theorem collarBump_rOut (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (n : ℕ) :
    (collarBump c hc n).rOut = radius c n := rfl

theorem smoothLift_tendsto (a s : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hs : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ s) (hs' : s ≤ 1)
    (φ : ℕ → ContDiffBump (0 : ℝ))
    (hr : ∀ n, s*a+(φ n).rOut < a)
    (ht : Tendsto (fun n => (φ n).rOut) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (g : V08I.logCarrier a) :
    Tendsto (fun n => smoothLift a s ha hs hs' (φ n) (hr n) g)
      atTop (𝓝 (compression a s ha hs hs' g)) := by
  let m : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ := fun n => 𝓕 (bumpComplex (φ n))
  have hm (n : ℕ) : Measurable (m n) :=
    (VectorFourier.fourierIntegral_continuous (L := innerₗ ℝ)
      Real.continuous_fourierChar continuous_inner (bumpComplex_integrable (φ n))).measurable
  have hb (n : ℕ) (u : ℝ) : ‖m n u‖ ≤ 1 := bump_fourier_norm_le (φ n) u
  have hlim : ∀ᵐ u ∂volume, Tendsto (fun n => m n u) atTop (𝓝 1) :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall (bump_fourier_tendsto_one φ ht)
  have he := weighted_multiplier_error_integral_tendsto a
    (compression a s ha hs hs' g) m hm hb hlim
  simp only [compression_physical] at he
  apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp he (ε^2) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have h := hN n hn
  change dist (∫ u, V08I.logWeight u *
      ‖((𝓕 (bumpComplex (φ n))) u-1) *
        (𝓕 (LogCarrierCompressionL2.compressedL2 a s (by linarith) g) : V08I.FullL2) u‖^2) 0 <
      ε^2 at h
  rw [← smoothLift_error a s ha hs hs' (φ n) (hr n) g,
    Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)] at h
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  by_contra hbad
  have hh := le_of_not_gt hbad
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hh)
    (show 0 ≤ ‖smoothLift a s ha hs hs' (φ n) (hr n) g -
      compression a s ha hs hs' g‖+ε by positivity)]

theorem interiorCore_dense (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    Dense (interiorCore a) := by
  intro g
  apply Metric.mem_closure_iff.mpr
  intro ε hε
  let s : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1-radius 1 n
  have hs (n : ℕ) : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ s n := by
    dsimp [s, radius]
    have h : (1:ℝ)/(2*((n:ℝ)+1)) ≤ 1/2 := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr
      linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
    linarith
  have hslt (n : ℕ) : s n < 1 := by
    dsimp [s]
    linarith [radius_pos 1 (by norm_num) n]
  have hs' (n : ℕ) : s n ≤ 1 := (hslt n).le
  have ht : Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    simpa [s] using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1:ℝ))).sub (radius_tendsto 1)
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp
    (compression_tendsto a ha.le g s hs hs' ht) (ε/2) (by positivity)
  let t := s N
  let c := a-t*a
  have hc : 0 < c := by
    dsimp [c,t]
    nlinarith [mul_pos ha (sub_pos.mpr (hslt N))]
  let φ := collarBump c hc
  have hr (n : ℕ) : t*a+(φ n).rOut < a := by
    change t*a+radius c n < a
    linarith [radius_lt c hc n]
  have hφ : Tendsto (fun n => (φ n).rOut) atTop (𝓝 0) := radius_tendsto c
  obtain ⟨M,hM⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp
    (smoothLift_tendsto a t ha.le (hs N) (hs' N) φ hr hφ g)
    (ε/2) (by positivity)
  let q := smoothLift a t ha.le (hs N) (hs' N) (φ M) (hr M) g
  refine ⟨q, smoothLift_mem_core a t ha.le (hs N) (hs' N) (φ M) (hr M) g, ?_⟩
  have h1 := hN N le_rfl
  have h2 := hM M le_rfl
  rw [dist_comm g q]
  exact (dist_triangle q (compression a t ha.le (hs N) (hs' N) g) g).trans_lt
    (by linarith)

end
end WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierInteriorDensity

import WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierDilationFourier
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.Convolution
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Bounds

/-! F4c3: actual normalized bump, Fourier error and interior support.
No assumption of pointwise smoothness of the original physical vector. -/
namespace WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierInteriorMollifier

open MeasureTheory FourierTransform
open scoped FourierTransform Convolution
open LogCarrierDilationFourier
noncomputable section

theorem bumpComplex_smooth (φ : ContDiffBump (0 : ℝ)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (bumpComplex φ) :=
  Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp φ.contDiff_normed

theorem bumpComplex_zero (φ : ContDiffBump (0 : ℝ)) (x : ℝ)
    (hx : φ.rOut ≤ |x|) : bumpComplex φ x = 0 := by
  have hz : φ.normed volume x = 0 := by
    by_contra hn
    have hmem : x ∈ Function.support (φ.normed volume) := hn
    rw [φ.support_normed_eq] at hmem
    have hlt : |x| < φ.rOut := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] using hmem
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hx) hlt
  simp [bumpComplex, hz]

theorem bumpComplex_compact (φ : ContDiffBump (0 : ℝ)) :
    HasCompactSupport (bumpComplex φ) := by
  apply HasCompactSupport.intro (K := Set.Icc (-φ.rOut) φ.rOut) isCompact_Icc
  intro x hx
  apply bumpComplex_zero
  exact le_of_not_ge (fun h => hx (abs_le.mp h))

theorem bump_fourier_error (φ : ContDiffBump (0 : ℝ)) (u : ℝ) :
    ‖(𝓕 (bumpComplex φ)) u - 1‖ ≤
      2 * Real.pi * |u| * φ.rOut := by
  let c : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi * |u| * φ.rOut
  let E : ℝ → ℂ := fun x => Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((-2*Real.pi*x*u : ℝ) : ℂ))
  have hE : Continuous E := by dsimp [E]; fun_prop
  have hB : Continuous (bumpComplex φ) := (bumpComplex_smooth φ).continuous
  have hcomp : HasCompactSupport (fun x => E x * bumpComplex φ x) := by
    apply HasCompactSupport.intro (K := Set.Icc (-φ.rOut) φ.rOut) isCompact_Icc
    intro x hx
    rw [bumpComplex_zero φ x (le_of_not_ge (fun h => hx (abs_le.mp h))), mul_zero]
  have hi : Integrable (fun x => E x * bumpComplex φ x) :=
    (hE.mul hB).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcomp
  have hmass : (∫ x, bumpComplex φ x) = 1 := by
    simpa only [bumpComplex, Complex.real_smul, mul_one] using
      (φ.integral_normed_smul (μ := volume) (1 : ℂ))
  have he : (𝓕 (bumpComplex φ)) u - 1 =
      ∫ x, E x * bumpComplex φ x - bumpComplex φ x := by
    rw [integral_sub hi (bumpComplex_integrable φ), hmass,
      Real.fourier_real_eq_integral_exp_smul]
    congr 1
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [] with x
    simp only [E, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm Complex.I]
  rw [he]
  apply (norm_integral_le_integral_norm _).trans
  have hbound (x : ℝ) :
      ‖E x * bumpComplex φ x - bumpComplex φ x‖ ≤ c * φ.normed volume x := by
    by_cases hx : φ.rOut ≤ |x|
    · rw [bumpComplex_zero φ x hx]
      simp only [mul_zero, sub_self, norm_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg (by dsimp [c]; positivity) (φ.nonneg_normed x)
    · rw [← sub_one_mul, norm_mul]
      have hphase : ‖E x - 1‖ ≤ |(-2*Real.pi*x*u : ℝ)| := by
        simpa only [E, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
          (Real.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal_sub_one_le (x := -2*Real.pi*x*u))
      have hphase' : ‖E x - 1‖ ≤ c := by
        apply hphase.trans
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg Real.pi_pos.le]
        norm_num
        dsimp [c]
        calc
          2 * Real.pi * |x| * |u| ≤ 2 * Real.pi * φ.rOut * |u| :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hx)) (by positivity))
              (abs_nonneg u)
          _ = _ := by ring
      rw [bumpComplex, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg (φ.nonneg_normed x)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hphase' (φ.nonneg_normed x)
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ x, c * φ.normed volume x :=
      integral_mono (hi.sub (bumpComplex_integrable φ)).norm
        (φ.integrable_normed.const_mul c) hbound
    _ = _ := by rw [integral_const_mul, φ.integral_normed, mul_one]; rfl

def smoothCompressed (φ : ContDiffBump (0 : ℝ)) (s : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℂ) : ℝ → ℂ :=
  bumpComplex φ ⋆[ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ] compress s f

theorem compress_integrable (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (f : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hf : Integrable f) : Integrable (compress s f) :=
  hf.comp_mul_left' (inv_ne_zero hs.ne')

theorem compress_zero (a s : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hs : 0 < s) (f : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hf : ∀ x, |x| > a → f x = 0) (x : ℝ) (hx : |x| > s*a) :
    compress s f x = 0 := by
  apply hf
  rw [abs_mul, abs_inv, abs_of_pos hs, ← div_eq_inv_mul]
  exact (lt_div_iff₀ hs).mpr (by linarith)

theorem smoothCompressed_smooth (φ : ContDiffBump (0 : ℝ)) (s : ℝ)
    (hs : 0 < s) (f : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Integrable f) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (smoothCompressed φ s f) := by
  unfold smoothCompressed
  change ContDiff ℝ ∞ (bumpComplex φ ⋆[ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℂ] compress s f)
  exact (bumpComplex_compact φ).contDiff_convolution_left
    (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℂ) (bumpComplex_smooth φ)
    (compress_integrable s hs f hf).locallyIntegrable

theorem smoothCompressed_zero (φ : ContDiffBump (0 : ℝ)) (a s : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hs : 0 < s) (f : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hf : ∀ x, |x| > a → f x = 0) (x : ℝ)
    (hx : |x| > s*a + φ.rOut) : smoothCompressed φ s f x = 0 := by
  unfold smoothCompressed
  apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
  filter_upwards [] with y
  by_cases hy : φ.rOut ≤ |y|
  · simp [bumpComplex_zero φ y hy]
  · have ht : |x| ≤ |x-y| + |y| := by
      calc
        |x| = |(x-y)+y| := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ _ := abs_add_le _ _
    have hz : |x-y| > s*a := by linarith [lt_of_not_ge hy]
    simp [compress_zero a s ha hs f hf _ hz]

theorem smoothCompressed_compact (φ : ContDiffBump (0 : ℝ)) (a s : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hs : 0 < s) (f : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hf : ∀ x, |x| > a → f x = 0) :
    HasCompactSupport (smoothCompressed φ s f) := by
  apply HasCompactSupport.intro (K := Set.Icc (-(s*a+φ.rOut)) (s*a+φ.rOut))
    isCompact_Icc
  intro x hx
  exact smoothCompressed_zero φ a s ha hs f hf x
    (lt_of_not_ge (fun h => hx (abs_le.mp h)))

theorem smoothCompressed_interior (φ : ContDiffBump (0 : ℝ)) (a s : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hs : 0 < s) (hr : s*a+φ.rOut < a) (f : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hf : ∀ x, |x| > a → f x = 0) :
    Function.support (smoothCompressed φ s f) ⊆ Set.Ioo (-a) a := by
  intro x hx
  have h : |x| ≤ s*a+φ.rOut := by
    by_contra hn
    exact hx (smoothCompressed_zero φ a s ha hs f hf x (lt_of_not_ge hn))
  exact abs_lt.mp (h.trans_lt hr)

theorem bump_fourier_tendsto_one (φ : ℕ → ContDiffBump (0 : ℝ))
    (hφ : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (φ n).rOut) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
    (u : ℝ) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (𝓕 (bumpComplex (φ n))) u) Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
  apply tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mpr
  have h := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := 2*Real.pi*|u|)).mul hφ
  simp only [mul_zero] at h
  exact squeeze_zero (fun n => norm_nonneg _) (fun n => bump_fourier_error (φ n) u) h

end
end WeilDefect.MasterReturn.LogCarrierInteriorMollifier
